header:
Can a raise make you
take home less?

cover.title: Can a Raise Lower Your Pay?

lines.text: Myth: a raise can push you into a higher tax bracket and leave you with less money.
lines.say: Myth: a raise can push you into a higher tax bracket and leave you with less money.

lines.text: Federal income tax brackets don't work that way. Only the dollars above each line get the higher rate.
lines.say: Federal income tax brackets don't work that way. Only the dollars above each line get the higher rate.

lines.text: Simple example: say the 22% bracket starts at 50,000, and your pay rises from 49,000 to 51,000.
lines.say: Simple example: say the twenty-two percent bracket starts at fifty thousand, and your pay rises from forty-nine to fifty-one thousand.

lines.text: That's 340 dollars in federal income tax. You keep the rest of the raise.
lines.say: That's three hundred forty dollars in federal income tax. You keep the rest of the raise.

scene.label: Extra federal income tax
scene.sub: the rest of the $2,000 is yours

lines.text: So take the raise. Higher brackets only touch the top slice.
lines.say: So take the raise. Higher brackets only touch the top slice.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.
lines.say: That's the money. Follow for more.
